timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I'll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you'll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let's begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I'm noticing tension somewhere in my body.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I've been carrying this without realizing it.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: It's okay that my body is holding onto something.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don't have to force this tension to leave.
I can let my body soften, even a little.
My shoulders are allowed to drop.
I can take one breath that reaches all the way down.
My body is allowed to feel more at ease.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I'm letting my body settle a little more.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Let this settle in your own time.
